metric_scope: Reference-relative proxy on real HX50 reads. 80% query-residue recovery per annotated P. pectinifera exon; CDS completeness excludes query gaps. This is not same-individual biological truth. Multi-contig coverage is a union of evidence, not proof all pieces belong to one copy.

before.wrong_merge_rate_reason: No same-individual genome or validated linkage truth for HX50; ambiguity rejection is not a measured false-merge rate.

after.wrong_merge_rate_reason: No same-individual genome or validated linkage truth for HX50; ambiguity rejection is not a measured false-merge rate.

exonerate.wrong_merge_rate_reason: No same-individual genome or validated linkage truth for HX50; ambiguity rejection is not a measured false-merge rate.

panel.selection: first 12 by long intron count, maximum intron length, family ID; CDS 300–4500 nt and >=3 exons
